cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(Blippy VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(QT_VERSION 6)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets Network)

add_executable(Blippy
    src/main.cpp
    src/core/input/InputManager.cpp
    src/core/placeholder/PlaceholderEngine.cpp
    src/core/substitution/SubstitutionEngine.cpp
    src/core/backup/BackupManager.cpp
    src/models/ComboModel.cpp
    src/types/Types.cpp

    # Qt resources
    src/Beeftext.qrc

    # MOC files - generated by uic
)

# Qt setup
target_link_libraries(Blippy PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Network)

# Install target
install(TARGETS Blippy DESTINATION bin)
